notes.list_status: unofficial; page states the list is updated until the 2026-08-21 14:00 deadline
notes.source_note: The page is now headed 'Certified List of Candidates - Municipal Council'; names sit under office headings as plain text with contact details beneath, not in a table.
notes.excluded_race: The regional councillor race is collected here but dropped by the build: see notes/excluded-races.csv. Kitchener's regional councillors sit on Regional Council, not on city council.
notes.other: The Regional Chair no longer appears on the ballot: under the Better Regional Governance Act, 2026 (2026-05-07) it became a provincially appointed position and no nominations for it may be filed or accepted.
notes.position: From the section headings, 'Ward 1 Councillor (Vote for no more than 1)' and 'Regional Councillor (Vote for no more than 4)'. The regional race is collected but excluded from the study.
notes.withdrawals: Three names carry a '- [WITHDRAWN]' suffix and are excluded here: Nair, Nitin and Rose, Danielle in Ward 5, and Kolsawala, Sajid among the regional councillors. Sajid Mohamed Farooq Kolsawala appears separately as a Waterloo Region District School Board candidate.
notes.name_change: 'Simson, Eve' among the regional councillors is now published as 'Simson, Eve Elizabeth'.
notes.regional_chair: The Regional Chair heading now carries only a notice that the Better Regional Governance Act, 2026 made the post a provincial appointment, that it will not appear on the ballot, and that nominations filed before the Act are deemed withdrawn. It is not a Kitchener council office and is not collected.
